message.dbzenith.great_ape_end: The moonlight fades. You collapse, exhausted.

race.dbzenith.human.desc: Versatile and quick to learn. +15% TP gain, techniques cost 15% less ki. Forms: Full Power, Buffed, Potential Unleashed. Racial: Solar Flare.
race.dbzenith.saiyan.desc: Born fighters with a tail. Cheap STR and Ki Power. Zenkai: recovering from near death makes you permanently stronger. Super Saiyan line and the Great Ape. Racial: Crimson Beam.
race.dbzenith.half_saiyan.desc: Balanced, smart and hidden potential. Smaller Zenkai, +5% TP gain, tail. Super Saiyan line plus Ultimate. Racial: Twin Wave.
race.dbzenith.namekian.desc: Regenerate three times faster, even soon after being hit. Cheap Spirit and Ki Power. Forms: Giant, Super and Orange Namekian. Racial: Regenerate.
race.dbzenith.frost_demon.desc: Born suppressed; each form releases more power. Need no air. Cheap DEX and Ki Power. Forms: Second, Third, Final, Golden. Racial: Supernova Orb.
race.dbzenith.majin.desc: Rubbery body that regenerates five times faster; kills restore 15% body. Cheap Constitution. Forms: Evil, Super, Pure Majin. Racial: Candy Beam.
race.dbzenith.android.desc: Never hungry, never tired, double ki regeneration, absorbs 30% of ki attacks as ki. Upgrades instead of forms. Racial: Energy Absorb.
race.dbzenith.cyborg.desc: Part machine: slow hunger, double stamina regen, absorbs 15% of ki attacks. Forms: Overclock, Full Conversion, Machine Mutant. Racial: Arm Cannon.
technique.dbzenith.ki_sense.desc: Feel every life force within 48 blocks: they glow, and you learn the strongest power levels.
technique.dbzenith.rapid_volley.desc: A spray of six small blasts.
technique.dbzenith.homing_orb.desc: A slow orb that curves toward its target.
technique.dbzenith.instant_step.desc: Vanish and reappear up to 10 blocks ahead.
technique.dbzenith.cutter_disk.desc: A spinning disk that slices through up to four enemies.
technique.dbzenith.explosive_wave.desc: Release ki in every direction, blasting everything within 5 blocks.
technique.dbzenith.wave_beam.desc: A sustained beam that follows your aim and explodes on impact.
technique.dbzenith.ki_heal.desc: Heal the player you look at (or yourself) by 20%.
technique.dbzenith.solar_flare.desc: A blinding flash: everything in front of you is blinded and slowed.
technique.dbzenith.crimson_beam.desc: A violet Saiyan beam, stronger than the Wave Beam.
technique.dbzenith.twin_wave.desc: A wide beam drawing on both heritages.
technique.dbzenith.supernova_orb.desc: A huge, slow orb of destruction.
technique.dbzenith.energy_absorb.desc: For 3 seconds, ki attacks restore your ki instead of hurting you.
technique.dbzenith.arm_cannon.desc: A fast, hard-hitting blast from your arm.
message.dbzenith.cannot_learn: You cannot learn anything from this scroll
screen.dbzenith.techniques_help: Click: learn / equip.  Click a deck slot to remove.
